thread:
Anna (Partnerships): Heads up — Skybridge PO is stuck in the marketplace portal. Procurement flagged a signatory/entity mismatch and won't auto-approve. Need help ASAP, customer expects deployment next week.
Raj (Sales): Ugh. Do we have the portal error? Can you paste the response or screenshot?
Anna (Partnerships): pasted the portal error below from the webhook:
marketplace-bot: ERROR 400: signatory_mismatch — PO signer 'Skybridge Solutions LLC' does not match billing entity 'Skybridge Technologies, Inc.'
Anna (Partnerships): Customer submitted their PO from Skybridge legal. Their procurement team insists on 'Skybridge Technologies, Inc.' as billing entity. Billing contact says they can't re-issue quickly.
Maria (Legal): @Anna can you confirm which entity is on the contract? If contract uses 'Skybridge Solutions LLC' we can route a redline or add an addendum. If the contract entity is different, we need an executed amendment.
Sabrina (Finance): For accounting we need the legal entity to match the PO exactly to generate invoices. Manual exception requires AP approval and a signed letter of authority from their CFO.
Raj (Sales): Customer is blocked on the Workspace deploy. They said re-issuing a PO would take 3–5 business days. Any temporary workaround?
Leo (Ops): Short-term option: we can provision in a non-billable sandbox account under partner demo quota so they can test. But we can't mark production usage until finance signs off.
Anna (Partnerships): Would finance be okay with a manual invoice and reliance on a signed letter while they reissue the PO? I can ask them to provide a scanned CFO letter and vendor registration.
Sabrina (Finance): I'm okay to start AP review if we have (1) scanned CFO letter with corporate letterhead, (2) vendor registration form, (3) confirmation email from their procurement. Send to invoices@ and loop me.
Maria (Legal): Also request a short addendum template from us — 1 paragraph acknowledging the entity variance and commitment to replace PO within X days. I can fast-track review if they sign it.
Raj (Sales): I'll ping the customer's procurement right now. @Anna please share the mailbox and I'll forward. ETA from them ~ end of day.
Anna (Partnerships): Sharing inbox: procurement@skybridge.example.com. I'll start collecting docs and ping here. If we get docs today, Sabrina — can AP triage tomorrow morning? :crossed_fingers:
Sabrina (Finance): Yes — if docs are in by 5pm PT I'll run it through AP tomorrow. Approver is Emily (AP Director) — copying her now.
marketplace-bot: Deployment hold recorded: ticket #MK-2319 created. Update the ticket with attachments to trigger AP workflow.
Anna (Partnerships): Thanks everyone — assigning action items: Raj to get procurement to send CFO letter, Anna to upload to MK-2319, Maria to prepare a one-paragraph addendum, Sabrina to submit to AP if docs arrive. I'll update the customer and mark this as escalated.
Raj (Sales): On it. Will report back here.
Anna (Partnerships): Closing note: customer timeline still tight; flagged for sales exec if docs slip beyond 48hrs. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
